journal.restless.bestiary.poltergeist: Loud and restless: doors, chests and belongings move on their own. Hardly dangerous at first.
journal.restless.bestiary.shade: A quiet spirit that puts out lights, whispers and slowly wears people down, growing crueler over time.
journal.restless.bestiary.shade.name: Shade
journal.restless.bestiary.phantom: Wants to pass for a living person and appears as a stranger far off or as a name that isn't there. Rarely hurts anyone.
journal.restless.bestiary.phantom.name: Phantom
journal.restless.bestiary.nix: Stays near water. Holds swimmers under, calls the player toward the shore and breaks boats.
journal.restless.bestiary.nix.name: Nix
journal.restless.bestiary.mimic: Fakes what isn't there: blocks, strangers and animals that later vanish.
journal.restless.bestiary.mimic.name: Mimic
journal.restless.bestiary.wraith: Hunts in the dark. First puts out the player's light, then comes closer.
journal.restless.bestiary.wraith.name: Wraith
journal.restless.bestiary.mara: Sits on sleepers. More dangerous at night, and most dangerous of all while the player is in bed.
journal.restless.bestiary.mara.name: Mara
journal.restless.bestiary.banshee: Little more than a voice: it makes a great deal of noise but barely touches anything.
journal.restless.bestiary.banshee.name: Banshee
journal.restless.bestiary.revenant: Out for revenge: it strikes the player, sends animals after them and remembers every kill.
journal.restless.bestiary.revenant.name: Revenant
journal.restless.bestiary.lost_one: Wanders, appearing as shapes, footsteps and strangers far off. Follows the player even underground.
journal.restless.bestiary.lost_one.name: Lost one
journal.restless.bestiary.domovoi: Lives in a house, moving doors and belongings and rustling in the corners. Mostly harmless.
journal.restless.bestiary.domovoi.name: Domovoi
journal.restless.bestiary.hoarder: Stays in one place and takes whatever is left lying there.
journal.restless.bestiary.hoarder.name: Hoarder
journal.restless.bestiary.demon: Stays in one place and is dangerous: it strikes, spreads sickness and sends animals against the player.
journal.restless.bestiary.demon.name: Demon
journal.restless.bestiary.trickster: Stays in one place and plays tricks: it changes blocks and items and shows things that aren't there.
journal.restless.bestiary.trickster.name: Trickster
journal.restless.bestiary.boggart: Fakes what disgusts: swarms of tiny spiders and vermin, visible only to the player, running at them.
journal.restless.bestiary.boggart.name: Boggart
journal.restless.guide.start.title: Before anything else
journal.restless.guide.start.1: The dead here do not rest. Some latch onto a living person and follow them wherever they go; others remain where they died.
journal.restless.guide.start.2: They begin weak, but the longer they are left alone, the stronger they grow. I learned that the hard way. Some things I never worked out, and so some of these pages stay blank.
journal.restless.guide.haunted.title: Signs
journal.restless.guide.haunted.1: Doors slam on their own, torches go out, and footsteps sound where nobody is walking. That is a spirit, and it will not stop of its own accord.
journal.restless.guide.haunted.2: A spirit candle leans toward whoever the spirit will go for next, and burns blue just before it arrives. Spirits cannot cross a closed ring of salt; I tested it myself.
journal.restless.guide.haunted.3: Only tools can tell which spirit is near. Ash shows its prints, a camera obscura takes its picture, and a spirit box and an ouija board speak with it, yet each shows only part of the truth.
journal.restless.guide.clues.title: Telling them apart
journal.restless.guide.clues.1: Every spirit has several habits, and a single clue reveals only one of them. I therefore never decided anything from one note, and waited until I had gathered a few.
journal.restless.guide.clues.2: Photos and ash prints never lie. The spirit box and the board sometimes do, so I marked every note from them "could be lying". In truth only a liar spirit lies, and then only about half the time. If the board and the box keep saying the same thing, it can be trusted.
journal.restless.guide.weakness.title: The altar
journal.restless.guide.weakness.1: A spirit can be banished at the altar, but its nature must be known first. There are four, Objects, Darkness, Malice and Deceit, and each has its own weakness. Objects fear iron, Darkness fears light (glowstone), Malice fears holy water, and Deceit fears a mirror, which shows the truth. Nearly all of a spirit's habits come from its nature, and only one does not fit.
journal.restless.guide.weakness.2: The nature shows in what the spirit does. When it touches things, slams doors, goes through chests and moves the world around it, that is Objects; when it reaches for darkness, cold and night, that is Darkness; when it takes revenge, holds grudges, comes with the rain or calls from the deep, that is Malice; and when it whispers, makes noise, steals sleep or lies, playing with a person's mind, that is Deceit.
journal.restless.guide.weakness.3: Ash does not lie. A paw means Objects, a drag mark means Darkness, a hoof means Malice, and a bare foot means Deceit. One of a spirit's habits is foreign and leaves a foreign print, so the print seen most often is the one to trust. Until ash had confirmed my guess I never went to the altar, for a mistake costs too much.
journal.restless.guide.weakness.4: Knowing the nature is not enough, for each kind of spirit takes it in its own form: some want the thing whole, some a bit of it, some something crafted from it. The bestiary says which, on the kind's page that appears after the first photo. Then I built an altar, set four lit candles around it, closed a ring of salt and laid the offering in the bowl. If the form was wrong, the spirit still took the offering, but the ritual dragged on.
journal.restless.guide.weakness.5: During the ritual the spirit fights back, putting out candles and striking. A candle that goes out must be relit at once. Getting the nature wrong is far worse: every candle goes out, the spirit flies into a rage, hides for a day and keeps people from the altar, and it comes a step closer to growing into something worse.
journal.restless.guide.graves.title: Graves
journal.restless.guide.graves.1: Every spirit used to be someone. The grave turned up a few hundred blocks from home, and the stone said who they were and what they had lost.
journal.restless.guide.graves.2: When I brought the lost thing to the grave, the spirit came to rest. It worked better than any ritual, and there was no nature to guess. When my mind began to fail, the spirit box told me where the bones lay.
journal.restless.guide.sanity.title: The mind
journal.restless.guide.sanity.1: Darkness, cursed ground and every scare wore me down, while light, food, sleep and salt brought me back.
journal.restless.guide.sanity.2: The worse my state, the more the spirit box picked up.
journal.restless.guide.evolution.title: Left alone
journal.restless.guide.evolution.1: A spirit left alone long enough turns into something worse, and it does not turn back. The ground around some of them goes grey.
journal.restless.guide.evolution.2: Once the spirit is banished or at rest, the ground comes back to life.
journal.restless.guide.essence.title: Essence
journal.restless.guide.essence.1: Some spirits leave essence behind. A ritual gave me one, and a grave put right gave more.
journal.restless.guide.essence.2: Every kind of spirit leaves its own essence, and charms are made from it. Poltergeist essence pulls dropped items in and shade essence allows sight in the dark, while the other charms are crafted from an essence and one common thing; the charm's name says whose it is.
restless.relighting.title: Relighting
restless.relighting.description: Right-click the placed light with flint and steel or a lit torch. Flint and steel loses 1 durability; torches are not consumed. Cannot ignite underwater.

journal.restless.met.shade: Where it's met: it may latch on from the very start, for no reason at all. A spirit can be summoned on purpose with an effigy, a scarecrow stuffed with its essence and set alight.
journal.restless.met.nix: Where it's met: it is found at shipwrecks and ocean ruins. A spirit can be summoned on purpose with an effigy, a scarecrow stuffed with its essence and set alight by the water.
journal.restless.met.phantom: Where it's met: it may latch on from the very start, for no reason at all. A spirit can be summoned on purpose with an effigy, a scarecrow stuffed with its essence and set alight.
journal.restless.met.mimic: Where it's met: it may latch on from the very start, for no reason at all. A spirit can be summoned on purpose with an effigy, a scarecrow stuffed with its essence and set alight.

journal.restless.met.mara: Where it's met: it may latch on from the very start, for no reason at all. A spirit can be summoned on purpose with an effigy, a scarecrow stuffed with its essence and set alight.
journal.restless.met.banshee: Where it's met: it comes when a villager or a pet dies before the player's eyes, or when a pet is lost. A spirit can be summoned on purpose with an effigy, a scarecrow stuffed with its essence and set alight.
journal.restless.met.revenant: Where it's met: it comes after a slaughter of animals and villagers, or after the player kills their own pet. A spirit can be summoned on purpose with an effigy, a scarecrow stuffed with its essence and set alight.
journal.restless.met.lost_one: Where it's met: it comes after the player dies far from home, or after two days without sleep. A spirit can be summoned on purpose with an effigy, a scarecrow stuffed with its essence and set alight.
journal.restless.met.domovoi: Where it's met: it is rarely found in villages. A spirit can be summoned on purpose with an effigy, a scarecrow stuffed with its essence and set alight.
journal.restless.met.hoarder: Where it's met: it is found in igloos and pyramids. A spirit can be summoned on purpose with an effigy, a scarecrow stuffed with its essence and set alight.
journal.restless.met.demon: Where it's met: it is found at ruined portals, ancient cities, bastions and fortresses. A spirit can be summoned on purpose with an effigy, a scarecrow stuffed with its essence and set alight.
journal.restless.met.trickster: Where it's met: it is found at swamp huts. A spirit can be summoned on purpose with an effigy, a scarecrow stuffed with its essence and set alight.

message.restless.bell_silent: The bell has nothing to give back.

message.restless.requiem_busy: A Requiem is already being sung here.

message.restless.requiem_aborted: The Requiem is broken off. Nothing is lost.
message.restless.requiem_failed: The Requiem fails. The essence (%s) is lost, the dead are angrier, and the altar will not answer for three days.
message.restless.requiem_bargain: A voice offers a bargain: be spared this movement for the price of %3$s candles. %1$s or %2$s?

message.restless.requiem_refused: You refuse. The voice goes quiet.

requiem.restless.cue.shade: The light dies around the altar. Keep at least 4 lights burning.
requiem.restless.cue.poltergeist: Your things fly from your pockets. Pick them all up again.
requiem.restless.cue.nix: Water rises in the circle. Do not drown, and keep the altar dry.
requiem.restless.cue.phantom: Strangers stand outside the ring. Do not look at them.
requiem.restless.cue.mimic: Two more altars have risen. Lay holy water on the true one.
requiem.restless.cue.wraith: Darkness, and blows from nowhere. Stay above three hearts, and keep to the light.
requiem.restless.cue.mara: A heavy sleep falls. Only a steady mind wakes.
requiem.restless.cue.banshee: A wail. Ring the bell when the silence comes.
requiem.restless.cue.revenant: The things you killed rise. Kill them all.
requiem.restless.cue.lost_one: You are lost. Find your way back into the ring in time.
requiem.restless.cue.domovoi: Doors slam open. Close every door near the altar.
requiem.restless.cue.hoarder: Your offering is stolen. It lies in one of the chests.
requiem.restless.cue.trickster: Candles go out and change places. Relight what was lit, and leave the false ones.
requiem.restless.cue.boggart: Spiders swarm at you. They are not real. Hold your ground by the altar.
journal.restless.guide.requiem.title: Requiem
journal.restless.guide.requiem.1: I carried one essence of every kind to the altar and sang them out. Their business was finished, and so, in the only way that counted, was mine.
journal.restless.guide.requiem.2: Nothing is born on me now, and nothing acts on me. The reliquary became a bell. If I miss them, I can crouch and ring it, and three of them will come back.
advancements.restless.requiem.title: Requiem
advancements.restless.requiem.descriptio: Sing every spirit out, and be let go
requiem.restless.title: Requiem
requiem.restless.poem.1: They came to you in the dark, each asking for one small thing:
requiem.restless.poem.2: a light, a name, a door, a hand to hold.
requiem.restless.poem.3: You learned their faces by what they took from you,
requiem.restless.poem.4: and their names by what they left behind.
requiem.restless.poem.6: Salt on the sill. A candle that would not stay lit.
requiem.restless.poem.7: Fourteen kinds of grief in one quiet box,
requiem.restless.poem.9: You sang it aloud, and it was not a spell.
requiem.restless.poem.11: Now the stones stand and the names are read.
requiem.restless.poem.12: The cold goes out of the rooms; the rooms are only rooms.
requiem.restless.poem.13: Nobody walks behind you. Nobody waits in the dark.
requiem.restless.poem.15: Go home. The night is only night.
item.restless.salt.tip: When placed in a ring, it keeps every spirit event off anyone standing inside.
item.restless.ash.tip: Spirits leave prints in placed ash that reveal one trait. It never lies.
item.restless.spirit_candle.tip: While held, its flame leans toward the spirit that acts next.
item.restless.camera_obscura.tip: When used, it takes a photo that shows the type of a nearby spirit.
item.restless.photo.tip: Shows the type of a spirit. Never lies.
item.restless.spirit_box.tip: Once placed, it answers questions around a clue word. It may lie.
item.restless.ouija_board.tip: Once placed and used, it spells out a trait. It may lie.
item.restless.door_charm.tip: Stuck to a block, it stops door events within 8 blocks. Breaks after 5 triggers.
item.restless.dreamcatcher.tip: When hung, it keeps events off a sleeper within 5 blocks.
item.restless.hallowed_lantern.tip: Spirit events do not affect players within 6 blocks of the lantern.
item.restless.scarecrow.tip: Stops any event within 16 blocks. Breaks after 10 triggers.
item.restless.effigy.tip: When stuffed with an essence and lit, it calls a spirit of that type.
item.restless.altar.tip: Spirits are banished here: the offering is made inside a salt ring among lit candles.
item.restless.essence.tip: A banished spirit's remains. Craft it into charms, consumables and relics.
item.restless.telekinesis_amulet.tip: When used, it pulls dropped items and experience to the holder.
item.restless.dark_eye.tip: When used, it grants sight in the dark and highlights living things and spirits.
item.restless.drowned_stone.tip: While worn, it allows free breathing and swimming in water; it slows the wearer on land.
item.restless.borrowed_face.tip: When used, hostile mobs take the user for one of their own for 25 seconds.
item.restless.phantom_double.tip: When used, it creates a copy of the user that draws hostile mobs for 8 seconds.
item.restless.wraith_shroud.tip: When used, blows pass through the user for 5 seconds.
item.restless.borrowed_dream.tip: When used, it restores sanity to full but angers the user's spirits. Works once a day.
item.restless.death_wail.tip: While worn, it throws hostile mobs back once health drops below 3 hearts. Works once a day.
item.restless.grudge.tip: While worn, it stores the damage the wearer takes; the next blow adds half of it.
item.restless.lost_step.tip: When used, it moves the user up to 8 blocks ahead, through thin walls.
item.restless.house_key.tip: While worn, it keeps spirits' events from running in a shut, roofed room.
item.restless.stash.tip: When used, it opens a slot for one stack. Kept in the inventory, it survives the owner's death.
item.restless.bargain.tip: When used, it grants full health and strong effects, after which maximum health drops by two hearts.
item.restless.trickster_coin.tip: When used, it wagers the next kill: its drops either double or are lost.
item.restless.fetch_path.tip: When used, it works as the Lost Step, leaving a copy of the user behind.
item.restless.changeling_mask.tip: When used, it works as the Borrowed Face; the first blow frames the mob that was hit.
item.restless.nightwalk_shroud.tip: While worn, hostile mobs lose track of the wearer in dim light and the wearer can pass through mobs. While held without Curios, using it toggles it.
item.restless.blood_debt.tip: While worn, it works as the Grudge with no cap; a killing blow heals the wearer.
item.restless.requital_wail.tip: While worn, it works as the Death Wail; mobs it throws back take more damage.
item.restless.tidecaller.tip: While worn, it works as the Drowned Stone and adds a dash in water and rain.
item.restless.magpies_hook.tip: While worn, it works as the Telekinesis Rod, but only for nearby items. When used on a container while sneaking, it links to it.
item.restless.truthseers_eye.tip: While worn, it grants the sight of the Dark Lens; the next reading cannot lie. Works once a day.
item.restless.hearth_dream.tip: When used in a shut, roofed room, it restores sanity to full without causing anger. Works once a day.
item.restless.keepers_key.tip: While worn, it works as the House Key, but is bound to one room, where it never wears.
item.restless.grave_satchel.tip: While worn, it works as the Stash for three stacks. After the owner's death it rests for three days.
item.restless.devils_coin.tip: When used, it works as the Trickster's Coin, wagering every kill for 30 seconds.
item.restless.twins_mirror.tip: When used, it creates a Phantom Double where the user is looking.
item.restless.black_bargain.tip: When used, it works as the Bargain, but with a longer fury and a cost in sanity rather than hearts.
item.restless.still_water.tip: When drunk, it clears the weather; when drunk while sneaking, it brings a storm. Afterwards the weather runs its own course.
item.restless.dreamless_draught.tip: When drunk before bed, it allows sleeping near monsters and waking calmer.
item.restless.wayfinders_ash.tip: When used, footprints lead to the place of death for 5 minutes; when used while sneaking, they lead to the spawn point.
item.restless.magpie_feather.tip: When used, it creates a stream of light for 5 minutes that leads to the nearest unopened loot chest or barrel.
item.restless.changeling_dust.tip: When used on a block, it swaps the whole joined body of it for kin; on a novice villager, it redoes trades.
item.restless.bloodied_rag.tip: When thrown, mobs of that type nearby go for it until it dies.
item.restless.wraith_oil.tip: When used with a weapon in the other hand, it grants 30 harder blows in the dark.
item.restless.infernal_contract.tip: When used with an enchanted item in the other hand, it raises one enchantment by a level.
item.restless.restless_knot.tip: When tied to a container, it makes the container take in dropped items nearby. Using it on the container while sneaking takes it back.
item.restless.dusk_salt.tip: When scattered, it keeps hostile mobs from spawning nearby. Using salt while sneaking near the spot sweeps it up.
item.restless.sighting_mark.tip: When placed, it shows through walls on every player's screen. Using it on the mark takes it back.
item.restless.mimic_clay.tip: When pressed on a block, it takes on that block's look and can then be set down. It turns the way it is set.
item.restless.omen_candle.tip: When lit, it announces the next harmful event nearby 5 seconds ahead, then goes out.
item.restless.domovois_porridge.tip: When eaten, it makes crops and young animals around the eater grow faster until death or until milk is drunk.
item.restless.hoarders_hollow.tip: A chest shared by all of the owner's hollows. It can be disguised with mimic clay.
item.restless.reliquary.tip: Holds one essence of every type, for the Requiem.
item.restless.requiem_bell.tip: Ringing it while sneaking for 5 seconds takes back the release.
item.restless.ferrymans_coin.tip: While worn, a killing blow fades the wearer instead. Rests 3 days.
item.restless.exorcists_censer.tip: While held in the off hand at the altar, it shortens the ritual, keeps the candles lit and yields one more essence.
item.restless.hollow_lantern.tip: Wards 24 blocks and writes a clue for every event it stops.
item.restless.maras_cradle.tip: This bed restores all sanity, and the night does not pass.
item.restless.gravestone.tip: When used, it can be read. Giving it what the spirit wants lays the spirit to rest.
item.restless.journal.tip: Records everything the owner learns about spirits.
item.restless.diary_page.tip: When used, it teaches one recipe.
